historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly rejects SSH-only visual certification, but its game requirement is unsupported by this row and must not be added to the execution contract.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Resolution support is a tuple of pixel dimensions, refresh rate, color depth/format and physical DP path. A mode may be selectable yet blank, unstable or slow to recover; every approved tuple needs direct scanout observation and local responsiveness, without importing an unrelated game.

original_test_intent: Verify manually that each owner-approved DP 1.4a resolution/mode is actually displayed on the physical monitor and the Windows display session remains responsive through each mode change.
original_method: Identify the exact GPU/DP/cable/monitor/Windows driver path and approved mode tuples, record baseline, have a qualified operator select each mode locally, directly observe pixels, stability and control responsiveness, record negotiation/recovery time and visual evidence, stop on blank/corrupted/unrecoverable output and restore the approved final mode.
manual_activity: A qualified operator changes every approved Windows display mode at the physical monitor, observes scanout and local responsiveness, records per-mode evidence and restores a safe final mode; the agent only collects corroborating metadata.
required_inputs: GPU UUID/serial and DP port map
Resolution, refresh, color-depth/format and scaling matrix
Safe fallback mode and local recovery path
Optional workload only if explicitly owner-supplied
safety_requirements: Do not invent a game or workload absent from source
Use approved cable/connector and ESD handling
Keep a known-good local fallback mode
Stop on blank, corrupted, unstable or unresponsive output
Do not repeatedly cycle an unrecovered mode
Preserve rather than clear Windows/BMC logs
Do not treat mode enumeration or screenshot as physical scanout proof
Record actual negotiated mode and recovery time
agent_execution_scope: Record GPU/display/cable, driver and logical topology identity
Collect operator photographs/video and responsiveness/timing notes
Package evidence without visual certification or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact mode tuples and display path
Approve local responsiveness and recovery criteria
Perform or supervise mode changes and direct observation
Stop/recover blank, corrupted or hung modes

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command can prove physical scanout and local responsiveness, so its manual boundary is correct. However, the asserted Elden Ring/game session is absent from Items, Procedure and Criteria and is excluded unless separately approved as an override.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No agent-executed visual command. Operator follows the owner-approved mode matrix on the physical DP display; read-only Windows/GPU mode/event capture is corroboration only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DP 1.4a and different-resolution display/responsiveness remain within the stated 5/10-minute activity; no unlisted game, resolution or refresh rate is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: PHYSICAL DP MODE-TUPLE AND RESPONSIVENESS MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each approved resolution/refresh/color tuple, record requested and actually negotiated mode, time to stable pixels, artifacts/blanking, local input response and restoration result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines 'different resolution' as an approved auditable matrix and explicitly rejects the unsupported game requirement while retaining direct physical observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Windows may advertise or capture a mode even when the monitor displays no signal, scales incorrectly or becomes unstable; logical metadata cannot replace physical pixels and local response.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported modes can leave the display blank or session difficult to recover; short visual checks may miss intermittent link errors unless dwell is owner-defined.

project_override_considerations: Approve exact resolution/refresh/color/scaling tuples, dwell and responsiveness action, acceptable transient blanking/recovery time, physical path, evidence method and fallback mode; add any application workload only through an explicit owner requirement, not DeepSeek text.
expected_evidence: Windows/image/driver, GPU/DP/cable/monitor identity and owner-approved mode matrix
Per-mode requested/negotiated tuple, direct photo/video, stability/artifact and local responsiveness observations
Negotiation/recovery timing and any unsupported/blank/hung-mode evidence
Optional Windows/GPU/EDID/event corroboration without log clearing
Restored final display state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require DP 1.4a multi-resolution display and responsiveness checks. DeepSeek's Elden Ring/game mention is a reference-review hallucination, not a Master source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual display purpose and criteria are identifiable. Exact mode tuples and recovery are owner inputs; execution remains MANUAL ONLY rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Removes an unsupported game requirement, binds resolution to complete display-mode tuples and adds direct pixels, responsiveness, timing, recovery and per-mode evidence without overstating remote observability.
independent_technical_reasoning: The framebuffer, negotiated DP link and observed panel output are separate layers. A screenshot verifies only rendered content, and an advertised mode only reports capability. The physical panel must show stable pixels while local control remains responsive for each negotiated tuple; otherwise the source criterion is not met even when Windows reports the requested resolution.
